bio: This is just one of the options in the diverse range of restaurants within the Das James hotel, which is housed in a former naval building at the marina. Here you can look forward to truly authentic Japanese cuisine in the form of two set menus: the James Sushi Menu and the Omakase surprise menu. The chic design with a subtle Far Eastern touch and the friendly, competent service create a harmonious atmosphere. Minato is an appealing alternative to the restaurant's Das Grace and James Farmhouse and, as such, has many regular guests....
